_comment: Byte ceiling per contract wasm, checked by scripts/check-wasm-sizes.sh after `stellar contract build`. Each was set at the size on 2026-10-30 plus about 20%, rounded up. Raise a budget deliberately, in the commit that needs the room, so growth is argued for rather than absorbed. coverage_ledger raised to 21700 on 2026-11-20 (18017 bytes + 20%) for per-reporter reports and the revoked-reporter check (#26, #27). coverage_ledger raised again to 23500 on 2026-11-25 (22948 bytes + 2.4%) for the reporter_last_post and asset_reporter_pairs views and the Assets listing index they walk (#138, #159); the two views were 2526 bytes on top of 20422. reporter_registry raised to 7500 on 2026-11-21 (6230 bytes + 20%) for time-locked upgrades (#30). The upgrade_fixture_* budgets equal their real contract's, since each fixture compiles that contract's lib.rs and is the same size (#30).
